stories.title: Flintshire: 44-tonne lorry recorded at 85mph during police speed checks on A55
stories.summary: A 44-tonne articulated lorry was recorded travelling at 85mph on the A55 at Broughton during police speed checks on Thursday afternoon. Officers from North Wales Police’s Roads Policing Unit stopped the vehicle during speed enforcement activity. stories.title: Shoplifting in Flintshire rose 16% last year as offences fell across Wales
stories.summary: Shoplifting recorded in Flintshire rose by 16% last year, even as it fell across Wales and England, new figures show. North Wales Police recorded 1,054 shoplifting offences in the county in the year to March 2026, up from 909 the year before, according to Office for National Statistics (ONS) data published on Thursday. stories.title: Driver caught on phone in Flintshire had no licence, insurance or MOT
